library(jsonlite)

# Study parameters
n <- 25
mean_increase <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
side <- "one.sided"

# Calculate Cohen's d
cohens_d <- mean_increase / sd

# For one-sample t-test:
# Null hypothesis: μ = 0
# Alternative hypothesis (one-sided, upper tail): μ > 0
# 
# Under the alternative hypothesis, the true mean is 0.2
# The test statistic is t = (sample_mean - 0) / (sample_sd / sqrt(n))
# Under H1, this follows a non-central t distribution with:
#   df = n - 1 = 24
#   non-centrality parameter λ = (true_mean - null_mean) / (σ / sqrt(n))
#                              = (true_mean) / (σ / sqrt(n))
#                              = d * sqrt(n)

df <- n - 1
ncp <- cohens_d * sqrt(n)

# For a one-sided test at alpha = 0.05, the critical value is the upper tail
# critical_value = t_{1-alpha, df}
critical_value <- qt(1 - alpha, df)

# Power = P(t_{df, ncp} > critical_value)
# This is the upper-tail probability of the non-central t distribution
power <- pt(critical_value, df, ncp = ncp, lower.tail = FALSE)

# Prepare result
result <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(toJSON(list(results = list(result)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))
